title: Extrude Curve Z Direction Flow
description: After selecting curves in extrude curve interaction, nothing happens. Should default extrude in Z with option to change direction.
summary: Extrude curve now runs a full distance step after selection: default direction +Z, optional direction pick (d), vertical Z rod for distance, then kernel commit. Fixed command.finish omitting model (empty diff), materializeInlineObjectPrimitives reading raw fixture primitive arrays, and Model.fromJSON passing raw objects into materialize.
